user_prompt: How has email open volume trended over the last 7 days? Give me a daily number.
judge_criteria: The answer provides 7 distinct daily values (one per day for the last 7 days).
Each value has a date label so the user can tell which day it refers to.
Days are presented in chronological order (oldest first or newest first, but consistent).
Values are concrete numbers (open counts or aggregate values), not vague.
